_comment: Maps Monarch Extractor output CSV column names to this app's internal transaction fields. Column name matching is case-insensitive and whitespace-tolerant. 'id_column' is the only strictly required entry -- upsert_transactions_by_monarch_id() cannot upsert without a stable id. These are placeholder best-guess defaults; confirm against a real Monarch Extractor output file before relying on this in production (see docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-02-monarch-autoupdate-reporting-design.md, 'Open items').
